concepts.title: Baudhayana-Pythagoras Theorem: Finding the Hypotenuse
concepts.definition: On any right-cornered triangle, the square built on the slant equals the two squares on the legs put together.
concepts.key_idea: Add the squares of the two legs; that total is the slant squared.

concepts.title: Baudhayana-Pythagoras Theorem: Finding a Missing Leg
concepts.definition: A missing leg comes from sqrt(hypotenuse^2 - known_leg^2).
concepts.key_idea: Subtract the square of the known leg from the square of the hypotenuse to find the square of the missing leg.

concepts.title: Generating Baudhayana Triples from Odd Squares
concepts.definition: Expressing an odd square number as the difference between consecutive squares yields a primitive right-triangle triple where the shorter leg and hypotenuse differ by one.
concepts.key_idea: An odd square equals the gap between neighbouring squares, handing over a triple whose slant and long leg differ by one.

concepts.title: Fermat's Last Theorem
concepts.definition: There are no non-zero whole number solutions satisfying x to the power n plus y to the power n equals z to the power n for any integer exponent greater than two.
concepts.key_idea: Powers only combine into another power when the exponent is two.
